svg.title: A human searches in small steps. A language model agent leaps into software that runs, outside good software. A human at the helm keeps its path smooth only for the leaps they can read
svg.desc: Three panels share a start point (dot), a dashed region of software that runs, and a ring inside it marking the goal, good software. A human takes six small round steps, each with a dot, along a smooth curve toward the goal and covers a short way. A dashed arrow points on toward the goal. A language model agent takes six leaps. At each step a jagged ball, pale at its center with its mass out along its spikes, shows the distribution of next steps that the language model and its harness induce. Each leap is one draw from it, landing at the far end of its longest spike. The agent lands inside the region that runs and misses the goal. With a human at the helm, checking one leap costs the human three round steps, so the human's six steps cover two leaps. For each of those two the human picks the spike that holds the heading toward the goal (red rings) over a longer one that veers off, so each leap makes more progress toward the goal and the path runs smooth. The agent takes its other four leaps alone: the path turns sharply at the first of them, zigzags, and lands in the region that runs, away from the goal.
